_about: Context for glossary review sheets, shared by every language: what each English term means and a real sentence from the site where it appears. The key is the catalog key the example comes from; review-export checks that it still exists and still contains the sentence. Batches are sent in the order listed, one at a time; terms keep their order. A key starting with "lesson:" is a lesson file under src/content/blog (lessons are English only), for a term the site's own copy does not use yet. Once a batch has been sent to anyone, its terms never change: add a new batch instead. See docs/plans/volunteer-review-material.md, section 10.
